sloka: नाग्निस्तृप्यति काष्ठानां तृणानां हरियूथपः ।नाग्नेर्नापि विशस्तानां राक्षसानां वसुन्धरा ।। 5.54.29 ।।।।
transliteration: nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṁ tṛṇānāṁ hariyūthapaḥ ।nāgnernāpi viśastānāṁ rākṣasānāṁ vasundharā ।। 5.54.29 ।।।।

translations.english: The flames of fire were shining like kimsuka flowers here, like salmali wood there, and like saffron flowers elsewhere.
